en:
The `server_host` configuration option in the HTTP integration is deprecated and will be removed.

If you are using this option to bind Home Assistant to specific network interfaces, please remove it from your configuration. Home Assistant will automatically bind to all available interfaces by default.

If you have specific networking requirements, consider using firewall rules or other network configuration to control access to Home Assistant.
sv:

Om du använder det här alternativet för att binda Home Assistant till specifika nätverksgränssnitt, vänligen ta bort det från din konfiguration. Home Assistant kommer automatiskt att binda till alla tillgängliga gränssnitt som standard. 

Om du har specifika nätverkskrav bör du överväga att använda brandväggsregler eller annan nätverkskonfiguration för att kontrollera åtkomsten till Home Assistant.

en: The `server_host` HTTP configuration option is deprecated

The deprecated `server_host` configuration option in the HTTP integration is prone to break the communication between Home Assistant Core and Supervisor, and will be removed.

If you are using this option to bind Home Assistant to specific network interfaces, please remove it from your configuration. Home Assistant will automatically bind to all available interfaces by default.

If you have specific networking requirements, consider using firewall rules or other network configuration to control access to Home Assistant.
